claim_scope: Named-taxon-inspired teaching art using basic recognizable form, not strict scientific reconstruction; no exact species/measurement/locomotion/coexistence claim.

reconstruction_notes.en: Original living inspired-by long-eye form only: smooth oval tripartite shell, coherent head/thorax/tail and tapered high eye towers rooted in the cephalon. AMNH named Asaphus kowalewskii reference supports conspicuous stalked eyes; does not establish this for the whole genus. Nominal75mm body, palette, shallow segmentation, pose and restrained ventral hints are art choices, not exact specimen/soft-anatomy/movement reconstruction.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创活体inspired-by，仅选高眼柱形态：光滑椭圆三叶甲，头胸尾连续，高眼柱渐细并根植头甲。AMNH具名Asaphus kowalewskii支持长眼柱，不推广为全属特征。75毫米名义体长、配色、浅分节、姿态及克制腹面提示均为美术设定，不是精确标本、软体或运动复原。

name.en: Asaphus eye-tower trilobite inspired teaching model
name.zh: Asaphus 高眼柱三叶虫灵感教学模型

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish smooth oval shell with conspicuously raised eye towers near the head centre in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以光滑椭圆甲，头部中央附近竖高眼柱搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。
